Hero_Banner: We serve the greater LA area!
point_1_content: We can perform minor repairs on your residential or commercial property. We've got decades of experience in diagnosing and fixing stubborn leaks, so if you're in Los Angeles and looking to get some repair work done, give us a call anytime!
point_2_content: If your roof's starting to show its age, or if you're just looking for an upgrade or a change, we offer free estimates for roof replacement. We use Class-A fire rated materials that are built to last, and all of our labor is backed up by warranty. Shingle, tile, metal, silicone, torch down...we can do it all!
point_3_content: Not sure whether you need your roof replaced? Got a property in escrow that needs an inspection? We can send out a licensed technician to inspect your property and prepare a report. No obligation.
point_4_content: We offer 24/7 emergency service for active leaks in the greater Los Angeles area. Give us a call and we'll be happy to help!
FAQ_1_content: We got our start in Santa Barbara in the 1980s. We've moved to Burbank, but we still provide the top-quality service our past customers have grown to expect
FAQ_2_content: We're fully licensed, bonded, and insured, and we're committed to treating your property as if it were our own
FAQ_3_content: All of the roofers and foremen we send to your property are employees of Casa Roofing Systems
FAQ_4_content: We provide safety training for our crews so that everything run smoothly on the job
FAQ_5_content: We provide a full magnetic sweep at the end of every job to ensure that nothing gets left behind
